speech.heard: India hits 90.3% primary completion. The USA hits 95.7%. Niger stands at 40.8%. It is the lowest of all 167 countries and territories. The USA hits 95.7%, while Indonesia hits 99.95%. The lowest completion rates are led by Liberia at 57.8%, Ethiopia at 54.4%, Burkina Faso at 52%. It counts new entrants in the last grade of primary education, regardless of age. How many children complete primary school where you live?
